objectives.label: Ask to borrow a book
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you'd like to borrow this book with 'Rad bi si izposodil ___' in the accusative.

objectives.label: Hand over your card
objectives.descriptorEN: Hand over your library card with the fixed 'Izvolite.'

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Good day, how can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan, izvolite?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi si izposodil to knjigo.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to borrow this book.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali imate to knjigo?
c1b.en: Good day. Do you have this book?

n2.speaker: npc
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda, prosim izkaznico.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Izvolite. Rok vračila knjige je 30 dni. Prijetno branje!
n3.en: Here you are. The return date is 30 days. Enjoy your reading!
n3.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Izvolite. Rok vračila knjige je 30 dni. Prijetno branje!
